$comment: The upsell / cross-sell registry (features adm-4, adm-5, sh-r7). Every card the kit can show on OUR screens comes from this list, plus whatever a plugin adds through the `<prefix>_kit_promotions` filter. Adding a product later (Zinn SEO, docs/843 S4) is a new row here: `kind: plugin` with its main_files and site, and the generic plugin copy renders it with no code change.

`kind` picks the copy: hosting | marketplace | platform | plugin | bundle. The copy itself lives in PHP (Promotions::copy()) so it is translated into every locale; a row carries no sentence of its own.
`url` must be on a host scripts/wp-promo-check.py allow-lists and must carry no query string (WordPress.org guideline 7: no referral tracking in dashboard advertising).
`slot`: `promo` rows form the hosting promotion card; `cross-sell` rows form the other card. The Add-ons screen lists every row.
